analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI remains in neutral territory at 43.6, showing continued mild weakness. MACD histogram is improving (-304.5596 to 587.0947) but still within a bearish convergence. A Higher Low pattern is forming with the 5-day low at 96,700 and the 20-day low at 82,500. However, the price has fallen below the SMA20 (103,198) and is attempting a rebound, lacking conviction for a trend reversal.
